reviews.review_description:
Drift protection and setting putter-hand stick off makes it possible to play even with my stick drift. That's a great addition, and well thought through. I wish more games had it.
Lost balls, and courses with special treats, are fun to find. 
The maps load fast and looks nice. I've enjoyed both single player and multiplayer matches.
Updated from 4 to 5 stars after new version added some of my feature requests. Developers who listen to user feedback deserve extra points. And the new course that contains an arcade with mini-games was a pleasant surprise.

developer_response.body: Thank you for the update and the kind words! Feedback like yours is exactly what shapes the game, and we're glad drift protection and the stick options make it comfortable to play. More courses are on the way, with ten lost balls hidden in each. See you at the clubhouse! - Moonrise Studios

reviews.review_description: i enjoy how this game lets us try courses before buying them and if we complete them we get to keep them. i hope that the game stays like this. five stars

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for the five stars! That's how we've been launching our new courses: each one opens with a free launch week, and if you finish a round during it, it's yours to keep. Dinosaur Valley is free through November 1, so there's still time to keep it, and more courses are on the way. See you on the greens! - Moonrise Studios

reviews.review_description: Visually impressive vibes and includes Meta Quest Achievements! 🙌

developer_response.body: Thank you! We're really glad you're enjoying the look and the achievements. There's more to find, too: every course hides ten lost balls, and more courses are on the way. See you at the clubhouse! - Moonrise Studios

reviews.review_description:
I spent a few minutes testing the tutorial and a solo round :
〰️ It’s a very pleasant experience, chill
〰️ there are plenty of customization options, and the shortcuts make things much easier.
〰️ confort option available (teleportation, snap turn...). 
My only complaint is the non-standard movement controls, which can't be changed (moving the left stick left or right makes you turn, whereas usually that would make you strafe—especially since you can already turn using the right stick!).

〰️The worlds are quite geometric but colorful and pleasing to the eye.
〰️There are several different worlds, each with plenty of fitting little obstacles.

For a free game, it’s more polished than most : well done !

And apparently, it supports multiplayer (though I haven't tested that).

Possible improvements:
- If you could allow the left stick to handle full movement—not just forward/backward—it would feel less disorienting.
- Translations would be great; I can help proofread the French version if needed.
- A Discord server?

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for the review thats very kind of you. Welcome to Moon Rise with More to come! Your feedback is invaluable. A discord server is a great idea!
